description: This source file defines the `VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync` class, which manages synchronization of voice wake triggers with a remote gateway, including starting/stopping sync tasks, handling push events, and applying global voice wake triggers. It interacts with components like `GatewayConnection`, `AppStateStore`, and logging facilities.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGlobalSettingsSync
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for synchronizing voice wake triggers between the local app state and the remote gateway, including managing background tasks and handling incoming push events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the background task that continuously refreshes triggers from the gateway and listens for push events, resubscribing if the stream finishes.

methods.name: refreshFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the latest voice wake triggers from the gateway and updates the local app state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an incoming push event related to voice wake changes, decoding payloads and updating app state accordingly.
